</html># IBM Db2 TechX Summit 2026 — Project Submission

> **PR Title Format (required):** `[Submission] quantumdefense: QuantumDefense Cybersecurity`
>
> **Folder Format (required):** `submissions/quantumdefense/`
>
> **Mandatory Next Step:** After opening this PR, submit the PR URL through the official Google Form provided by the organisers.

---

## 1. Project Overview

- **Project Title:** QuantumDefense – Intelligent Cybersecurity System
- **Project Slug (must match folder name):** `quantumdefense`
- **Short Description (1–3 sentences):** QuantumDefense is a cybersecurity monitoring prototype designed to identify suspicious security events and unusual activity patterns. It combines rule-based detection, an Isolation Forest machine learning model, and database storage through a Flask-based dashboard.
- **Problem Solved & Target Audience:** The project helps students, developers, and cybersecurity teams understand and monitor suspicious security activities through automated detection, alerts, and a central dashboard.

---

## 2. Team Information

- **Team Name:** Astra
- **Team Members:** 1

| Full Name | GitHub Username | Email / Role |
|---|---|---|
| Nagaraj Naik | @M1551D1A | [naiknagaraj374@gmail.com](mailto:naiknagaraj374@gmail.com) / Project Developer |

---

## 3. IBM Db2 Integration Summary

- **IBM Db2 Edition / Environment:** IBM Db2 – connection module and SQL schema prepared; live database connection pending.
- **How IBM Db2 is Used in the Solution:** The project includes an IBM Db2 integration module designed to store and retrieve security events, security alerts, and machine learning analysis results.
- **Db2 Connector / Driver / Framework Integration Used:** Python `ibm_db` driver.
- **Schema & Data Stored / Processed:**
  - `SECURITY_EVENTS` – security event information.
  - `SECURITY_ALERTS` – detected security alerts.
  - `SECURITY_AUDIT` – audit records.
  - `ML_ANALYSIS_RESULTS` – machine learning analysis results.
- **Steps to Verify Db2 Integration:** Configure the Db2 connection details in the `.env` file, execute `sql/schema.sql` on the Db2 database, set `DB_BACKEND=ibmdb`, and test the connection and database operations.

**Note:** Live IBM Db2 connection testing is pending because database credentials have not yet been provided. SQLite is currently used for development and testing.

---

## 4. Technology Stack & AI / LLM Usage

- **Programming Languages:** Python, HTML, CSS.
- **Frameworks & Libraries:** Flask, scikit-learn, NumPy, python-dotenv, ibm_db.
- **AI / LLM Framework (if applicable):** scikit-learn.
- **Model Provider & Model Name (if applicable):** Isolation Forest.
- **Where AI/ML is Applied in the Workflow:** The Isolation Forest model analyses network activity metrics to identify unusual patterns. Rule-based detection identifies predefined suspicious security events and generates alerts.

---

## 5. Demonstration & Links

- **Live Demo URL (if hosted):** Not hosted.
- **Demo Video (YouTube / Loom / Drive):** Not available.
- **External Source Repo (if hosted separately):** https://github.com/M1551D1A/IBM_Db2_TechX_Project_Submission
- **Project Directory:** `submissions/quantumdefense/`
- **Presentation / Slides URL (optional):** Not available.

---

## 6. Submission Verification Checklist

- [x] **Folder Structure:** Project files are placed under `submissions/quantumdefense/`.
- [x] **Naming Conventions:** Project slug is `quantumdefense`, using lowercase letters.
- [x] **Complete Documentation:** README.md and architecture.md are included.
- [x] **Metadata File:** submission.json is completed and valid JSON.
- [x] **No Secrets or Credentials:** `.env.example` contains placeholders, and the local `.env` file is excluded from Git.
- [x] **Tested Setup Instructions:** The application and automated tests have been run in the development environment.
- [x] **License Declared:** Pending verification.
- [x] **Code of Conduct:** Team member agrees to follow the repository Code of Conduct.
- [x] **Scope Isolation:** Verify that the PR changes only files inside `submissions/quantumdefense/`.
- [x] **Google Form Submission:** I will submit the PR URL through the official Google Form after opening the PR.

---

## 7. Additional Notes for Reviewers & Judges

QuantumDefense includes a Flask-based cybersecurity dashboard, rule-based security event detection, an Isolation Forest anomaly detection prototype, SQLite storage, and an IBM Db2 integration module.

All 14 automated tests passed successfully in the development environment.

The machine learning model currently uses synthetic training data, and security events are simulated. Live network monitoring, live IBM Db2 connection testing, quantum computing, quantum-resistant cryptography, and blockchain integrity verification are not yet implemented.

Thank you for reviewing our project.
